proposed_replay_order: After separate researcher approval, freeze exact code/config/scorer/support/C64/tape identities and the private label linkage.
Reuse score arrays, memory transition chains, tape positions, and exact C64 transport for the common trajectory.
Use a verified private feature cache only if its exact provenance and full queried-image coverage are proven; otherwise encode each unique query image once.
At each required memory/evidence revision, score eligible queried anchors under current memory; exclude a normal anchor's source group from every Greedy layer.
Share version-addressed evidence with B4, B7, and Stage075BOffset. No controller may change the query tape, writer, or event scores.
Run score-only B5 rows on CPU from the shared scalar stream; retain native startup missingness and separate fallback rows.
Keep labels, features, and checkpoints private; emit immutable checksummed method outputs and measured resource usage.
